title: 363 of 2855 comment units in the D5-s3 cells carry a sentence over 40 words (criterion C5)
claim: 363 of the 2855 D5 units (comments and docstrings) of custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/{_,a..i}*.py contain at least one sentence over 40 words, failing D5-criteria C5; 43 of 45 files carry one, coordinator.py the most (91).
mechanism: Comments accrete clauses (history, cross-references, issue ids) into single sentences; the longest measured run past 100 words (const.py VENT_CUSUM_REFERENCE_HOURS block).

evidence.unit: units with a sentence over 40 words
evidence.contention_note: other finder seats running on the shared box; count is contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: inspect.getsource(custom_components.heatpump_optimizer.<module>) for each cell module, split by tools/audit/text_ledger.py:units_of/sentences

perturbation.change: --perturb: in dhw_planner's source, a full stop after word 30 of every over-long sentence (in memory)

metric_definition: Count of D5 units in the seat's cells with any sentence (text_ledger.sentences, comment markers stripped) longer than 40 whitespace-separated words.
phenomenon_property: No comment or docstring sentence in production exceeds 40 words (D5-criteria C5).
proposed_fix_scope: Split sentences file by file as files are touched; the per-file list the harness prints is the work order. The splitter is textual: an abbreviation splitting early only lowers the count.
